SELECT pos.CDATE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(ifnull(pos.BALANCE_QTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(ifnull(pos.BALANCE_AMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM CHB_PRD_POSITION pos left join chb_prd_baseinfo info on info.prod_id = pos.prod_id and info.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is null left join chb_prd_baseinfo finfo on finfo.prod_id = pos.prod_id and finfo.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is not null where 1=1
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},DATE_FORMAT(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') from dual
group by pos.CDATE,pos.PROD_ID,pos.CCY,pos.BUY_PLACE,pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(pos.DEALDATE ,'%Y%m%d') CDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(ifnull(pos.PRINQTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(ifnull(pos.DEALAMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL pos where 1=1 and pos.DEALTYPE='1' and (pos.BUY_PLACE not in('210200','330200','350200','370200','440300') or pos.BUY_PLACE is null)
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},DATE_FORMAT(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y%m%d') from dual
group by pos.DEALDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID, pos.CCY, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

with tab as ( select * from ( select concat('buyplace',a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.BUY_PLACE) AS code, list.ITEM_VALUE,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1, a.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUM rmbje, a.INIT_RAISING_QTY rmbfe, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.pbc_prod_id,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.CCY ORDER BY ifnull(a.STATUS_DATE,a.CREATE_TIME) DESC) RANKNUM from PBC_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB a LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST list ON a.CCY=list.ITEM_CODE and list.DICT_CODE='CURRENCY_CHB' where a.pbc_prod_id= #{pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )t where t.RANKNUM=1 ) SELECT tab.code,tab.rmbje,tab.rmbfe from tab union all select 'buyplace4000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='4' union all select 'buyplace5000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='5' union all select 'buyplace6000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='6' union all select 'buyplace7000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='7' union all select 'buyplace8000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='8' union all select 'buyplace9000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='9'
